sections.title: Library hours
sections.text: The library opens at 08:00 and closes at 20:00 on weekdays. Weekend access ends at 16:00.

sections.title: Borrowing books
sections.text: Students may borrow three books for fourteen days. Reference books cannot leave the library.

sections.title: Laboratory access
sections.text: The teaching laboratory requires an induction before access. Book a slot with the lab coordinator.

sections.title: Registration
sections.text: Course registration closes on the second Friday of the semester.

sections.title: Housing
sections.text: Housing requests use the residence portal. Accommodation is not guaranteed.

sections.title: Student support
sections.text: The student support office accepts appointments from 10:00 to 14:00 on weekdays.
